summary:
Wonersh is a village and civil parish in Surrey, within the Waverley district and Surrey Hills National Landscape. It lies southeast of Guildford and includes Shamley Green and Blackheath.

Settlement dates back at least to Anglo-Saxon times. The parish has evidence of Stone Age activity and six medieval manors. Its economy once centred on the West Surrey cloth trade; today it is mainly service-based. The area includes three conservation areas, listed churches and historic buildings, including Great Tangley Manor and Barnett Hill.

Wonersh has a village shop, post office, pub, school, health centre and facilities for sport and community groups. St John the Baptist’s church includes 12th-century remains. St John’s Seminary, which opened in 1891, closed in 2022.

The parish includes commons, woodland and parts of Winterfold Wood and Heath. The B2128 connects the village to Guildford, Cranleigh and Shamley Green. Shalford is the nearest railway station; a local station closed in 1965.
